2607.13452.title: Symbiosis-Inspired Knowledge Distillation for Incremental Object Detection
2607.13452.paper_summary: Incremental object detection (IOD) aims to extend detectors to new categories while retaining previously acquired knowledge. Existing methods often adopt a class incremental learning perspective, separating feature spaces to sharpen decision boundaries. However, this separation-oriented paradigm may overlook object symbiosis in detection, where co-occurrence and occlusion introduce spatial and semantic dependencies that benefit from shared representations. Ignoring these dependencies distorts the shared representations, exacerbates confusion between old and new classes, and accelerates catastrophic forgetting. To address this, we propose Symbiosis-Inspired Knowledge Distillation (SIKD), which explicitly leverages object symbiosis at two complementary levels. Spatial Symbiosis Distillation (SpSD) focuses on symbiotic regions where the old model responds with high overlap to objects in the new task. It preserves generalizable old class cues, suppresses class-specific bias and redundancy, and distills the refined evidence to the new model at matched spatial locations with slot-aligned supervision. Semantic Symbiosis Distillation (SeSD) maintains class level structure by forming confidence weighted prototypes for old classes and aligning their inter class soft ranks over the old class logits, which stabilizes the semantic topology during adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.
2607.13452.paper_summary_zh: 增量物體檢測（IOD）旨在將檢測器擴展到新類別，同時保留先前獲得的知識。<lb/>現有方法通常採用類別增量學習的視角，分離特徵空間以加強決策邊界。<lb/>然而，這種以分離為導向的範式可能忽略了檢測中的物體共生，因為共現和遮擋引入了空間和語義依賴，這些依賴從共享表示中受益。<lb/>忽略這些依賴會扭曲共享表示，加劇舊類別和新類別之間的混淆，並加速災難性遺忘。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了共生啟發的知識蒸餾（SIKD），它在兩個互補層面上明確利用物體共生。<lb/>空間共生蒸餾（SpSD）專注於舊模型對新任務中的物體高重疊響應的共生區域。<lb/>它保留可泛化的舊類別線索，抑制類別特定的偏見和冗餘，並在匹配的空間位置以插槽對齊的監督將精煉的證據蒸餾到新模型中。<lb/>語義共生蒸餾（SeSD）通過為舊類別形成信心加權原型並對齊它們在舊類別邏輯中的類別間軟排名，維持類別層級結構，這在適應過程中穩定了語義拓撲。<lb/>大量實驗證明了所提出方法的有效性和優越性。
